subject: phy-u-fund
title: PHY.U.FUND.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-17 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One), opening Braxton's elaboration of 'the spectacle-diversion sequence of American progressionalism — involving what this phenomenon has posed for western affinity dynamics and expansion as well as creativity.' (C)PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance): the question is what the physical universe fundamental requires to produce composite continuance, when the culture's actual generative apparatus is spectacle-diversion. SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) branches from the main line and opens into S-PROJ (source projection). PRI-INFO (principle information) branches from the main line and opens into RE-ST (restructuralism) → RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from the main line and opens into SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) → ACT-T (actual terms).
